title: The Battle Against Og, King of Bashan
description: Moses tells how Israel defeated Og, king of Bashan, the last of the giants, and took over his entire kingdom with sixty fortified cities in the region of Argob. The cities were devoted to destruction as they had done with Sihon. The chapter also describes the distribution of the land east of the Jordan—from the Arnon to Hermon—to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, with Jair and Makir mentioned separately.
